authority.note: Cache file names, date bounds, parser implementation, panel schema, and prior control specification were inspected before registration; candidate outcomes were not.

frozen_inputs.provenance_limit: The historical HTML caches lack sidecar observation metadata. Publication timestamps can enforce event-time PIT, but archive finality and observation-time provenance cannot be proven. Results must remain exploratory.

time_mapping.assignment: Each disclosure is assigned to the first panel session whose cutoff is at or after published_at.
time_mapping.new_overnight_event: Only same-session premarket, prior-session post-close, or intervening non-session disclosures enter title bundles. Intraday disclosures from an earlier session are excluded because the market could already trade them.
time_mapping.strict_source_complete: For a target session, every calendar-date HTML page from the previous panel session through the target session inclusive must exist. Source-missing sessions are excluded, never encoded as no-event.
time_mapping.no_event_definition: No qualifying disclosure for a code on a strict-source-complete target session.

sample.training: All strict-source-complete cached sessions strictly before each scoring month with observed outcomes and the applicable eligibility flag.
sample.score: Frozen panel score window 2024-07-01 through 2025-07-31, restricted to strict-source-complete sessions.
sample.walk_forward: Refit at each calendar month. Minimum 20 prior complete sessions and 100 qualifying event-code bundles.

controls.N0_no_event_L4: L4 ranking after excluding qualifying event codes on strict-source-complete sessions; diagnostic no-event baseline

title_representation.bundle_text: Titles joined in publication-time order with a separator token.
title_representation.rank_target: Within-session percentile of observed open-to-close return, transformed to [-1,1].
title_representation.value_target: Open-to-close return clipped to training 1st/99th percentiles and then clipped to [-10,10] percentage points.

registered_hypotheses.model: char TF-IDF Ridge on rank target
registered_hypotheses.policy: rank only qualifying overnight event stocks; unfilled slots are cash

registered_hypotheses.model: char TF-IDF Ridge on clipped value target
registered_hypotheses.policy: rank only qualifying overnight event stocks; unfilled slots are cash

registered_hypotheses.model: separate L4 and title rank models
registered_hypotheses.policy: daily combined score = L4 percentile + 0.5*(event title percentile-0.5) for event stocks; no-event stocks retain L4 percentile

registered_hypotheses.model: separate L4 and title value models
registered_hypotheses.policy: daily combined score = L4 percentile + 0.5*(event title percentile-0.5) for event stocks; no-event stocks retain L4 percentile

registered_hypotheses.model: regularized dense Ridge on global TF-IDF novelty, same-code novelty, and title rarity plus structured event features
regularized dense Ridge on document count, bundle width, age, same-day market event congestion, and code prior-event frequency
regularized dense Ridge on preregistered positive/negative title families, corroborating family count, and mixed-sign contradiction
regularized dense Ridge on novelty, intensity, congestion, and corroboration/contradiction features
separate L4 and T08 structured rank models
registered_hypotheses.policy: same fixed 0.5 centered percentile overlay as T03
top1 uses best positive-prediction event when available; remaining slot(s) use L4 excluding that code; otherwise L4

estimator.target: same rank target as the title rank model

novelty: 1 - maximum cosine similarity to any training title bundle
1 - maximum cosine similarity to a training title bundle of the same code, with 1 for unseen code
mean inverse-document-frequency of nonzero title terms
intensity_congestion: log1p latest information age in hours
log1p number of qualifying marketwide bundles for that target session
log1p number of qualifying marketwide documents for that target session
log1p prior complete-session event count for the code over 60 sessions

evaluation.slot_weighting: equal; absent event-only slots are cash
evaluation.primary_metric: mean daily net return at 40 bps
secondary: top 10 profit-contributing codes replaced by cash
coverage, event-day count, and slots filled
evaluation.multiplicity: Exploratory family; no production claim even if a point estimate wins.

informational_requirements: positive 40bp mean in both confirmation slices
positive 20bp mean after replacing top-10 profit codes by cash
positive in at least 3 of 5 scored calendar months
better than L4 at 40bp without reducing daily candidate coverage
